mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate is causally associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that supports strong corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and high employment levels (PAYEMS > 140000) indicates a robust labor market that drives corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of negative returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400.0 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when HOUST is below 1400.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent expansion in industrial production (INDPRO > 100.0) and housing starts (HOUST > 1400.0) indicates a broad-based economic upturn, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of residential sales (RSAFS) reflects strong consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic health and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between RSAFS and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals sustained economic momentum that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of positive returns in this regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
